title: Source
description: A work: a publication, dataset version, database record, chart, text or inscription. One record per work; claims cite it with a locator.

kind.description: What sort of evidence it is (schema/vocab/sources.yaml)

authors.description: "Surname, Initials" each; quote them in YAML, or a flow list splits every name at its comma

published.description: The year of publication: when the source was written is a fact about the source

written.description: When a text from before printing was written, often a range; `published` is then the year of the edition or translation quoted

snapshot.description: For a database record: the date of the snapshot read

via.description: How this source reached us, if not directly

verified.description: What has been checked against the source itself, by whom and how
